audio.rule: Pick one song that fits the set's theme (or the fallback) and write one line in the email: Audio idea: search 'song' in Instagram's music library.

captionRules: Voice: warm, reverent, plain. Written like a friend, never a sermon. Nothing that scolds or pressures.
No em dashes anywhere. No hype words. No exclamation marks. At most one emoji, and only the candle (🕯️) on the sign-off line, or none.
Line 1 is the hook and must stand alone in under 110 characters, because Instagram cuts the caption there: name a felt need or a quiet truth in plain words.
Then one to three short sentences that open the theme. You may echo a few words of the first verse. Do not retype whole verses; they are on the cards.
Then the references on one line, e.g. 'Philippians 4:6, 4:7 and 4:8 (BSB)' or 'Isaiah 41:10, Psalm 56:3, Deuteronomy 31:6 (BSB)'.

Then one primary call to action and one secondary, rotating across days: save it for the day you need it; send it to someone carrying a lot; comment which slide you needed (1, 2 or 3); read the whole chapter free in Chasten.
Sign-off line: 'Chasten is a free Bible app. chasten.ai' (the candle emoji may go before it).
Hashtags on their own line at the end: the core set plus two or three theme tags, twelve to fifteen total, lowercase.
Keep the whole caption under 1,200 characters including hashtags.
emailRules: Subject: 'Chasten IG · <Mon DD> · posted: <set title>' when published, or 'Chasten IG · <Mon DD> · needs a hand: <set title>' when publishing failed.

Keep it short. Ric wants to know it went out and what audio to put on it, nothing more. Four things in this order and nothing else: (1) one line saying it posted, with the Instagram permalink as a link, or if it failed, one line naming what failed and saying the cards are on the dashboard to post by hand; (2) one line reading Audio idea: search SONG in Instagram music library, choosing SONG from the audio map by theme; (3) the three cards inline as tags whose src is the public raw.githubusercontent.com URL, width 170, side by side; (4) the dashboard link. No recipe line, no verse list, no caption block, no explanation of what the run did.
Never read image bytes or base64 into the message and never send attachments. The cards are already public URLs, so reference them with . Attaching base64 has hung the run before.

host.note: github = push the JPEGs to the repo above, then publish through Composio using the raw.githubusercontent.com URLs. Set mode to none to prepare and email only.

reels.note: Tone is the single source of truth for a Reel. themeTone picks it from the verse set's theme; voiceByTone and sceneByTone both read from it, so imagery and narration always agree.

sceneByTone.intimate: close and quiet, shallow depth of field: mist lying on grass, still water, dew on stems, a single candle, light through a window
sceneByTone.gentle: open and warm: meadows at first light, fields of wildflowers, sun through trees, a river bank, gentle hills
sceneByTone.grand: vast and awe filled: mountain peaks above cloud, storm light over open ocean, wide sky, immense scale

render.audio: narration only, no music bed. Ric layers an Instagram instrumental after download, which keeps the trending audio surface available.
